# Specs

Every agreed spec of the Space is published as one file in this folder. This index has one line per agreed spec, in the same form as the indexes of the Lore:

```
- [file-name.md](./file-name.md): one sentence that says what the spec is about.
```

How a spec is written, and which sections it has, is described in the mirror of this publish area, `lore/mirrors/publish.md`.

No spec has been published yet.
